source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Detecting and Preventing Intrusions (PDF 128, printed 124).

blocks.text: Intrusions (be-ijazat dakhal) pakarne aur rokne ka matlab hai computer ya network tak unauthorized access ko pehchanna aur rokna. Cyber intrusion tab hoti hai jab hackers kamzoriyon se faida utha kar data churate ya systems kharab karte hain. Monitoring tools aur security software ghair-mamooli sargarmi ko track karte hain jo hamle ki nishani ho sakti hai. Talaba seekhte hain ke jaldi pakarna bare nuqsan se bachata hai aur systems ko mehfooz chalta rakhta hai. Hoshyar rehna aur security ke intezamat update karte rehna intrusions se hifazat ke aham qadam hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba namoone ke system logs (system ka record) ya screenshots dekh kar mashkook kaam dhoondein.

blocks.prompt: Intrusion kya hai aur early detection (jaldi pakarna) kyun faidemand hai?
blocks.explanation: Intrusion kisi computer ya network mein be-ijazat (unauthorized) dakhla hai, jab hackers kamzoriyon (weaknesses) se faida utha kar data churate ya system kharab karte hain. Jaldi pakarne se bare nuqsan ruk jate hain aur system mehfooz chalta rehta hai.

items: Intrusion detection: be-ijazat rasai pehchanna aur rokna.
Monitoring tools, security software aur updated security measures.
